title: Saturday Commons — PointCast 25 / 2029 Field Kit
dek: Four stadium views, three fan rituals, three campus third spaces, two lo-fi carry studies, twenty-five stamps, eight procedural backgrounds, and a three-line invitation machine
body:
Saturday, Rebranded made twenty-five original place-derived identity systems. Saturday Commons asks what happens after the mark leaves the screen.

The second 2029 presentation looks away from the fifty-yard line. Its four stadium views focus on the transit porch, rainy student end, nighttime band terrace, and the same concourse reopened as a Monday market. Three fan rituals turn arrival, section radio, and the postgame meal into acts of participation. Three campus third spaces make room for public printing, quiet listening, and a rooftop weather club. Two lo-fi carry studies collect radios, stamps, paper, repair tape, blankets, ear protection, and other useful objects that do not require a login.

The human edition is also a browser-local design instrument. Visitors can combine any of the twenty-five original marks with eight procedural background recipes, export a PNG, download a stamp proof, keep up to eight stamps locally, and generate bounded three-line Saturday invitations. Nothing is uploaded and no new telemetry is added.

This is an unofficial speculative editorial design project. It is not commissioned, approved, licensed, or endorsed by any school, conference, athletic program, stadium, or governing body. The environments are not announced plans, and the accessories are not licensed merchandise or products for sale.

media.alt: An imagined 2029 civic stadium entrance built as a timber transit porch with tram, bicycle repair, rain channel, native planting, and students in abstract color-block gear
